<table border="0" align="center" style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
  <tr>
    <td>
<p>The <b>@</b><b>start</b><b>@</b> / <b>@</b><b>end</b><b>@</b> & <b>@</b><b>else</b><b>@</b>  constructs act on the number of occurences.</p>
<p>The <b>{first}</b> & <b>{last}</b> tags are part of the special <a href="http://localhost/pad/manual/?pages/properties">Properties</a> tags.</p>
</p>
</td>
  </tr>
</table>

<p>Now the same code with an empty array</p>
<p>The {pad:else} construct comes active when there are zero occurences for a PAD tag.</p>
